title: Fox Touts Guanajuato Tech Strategy, Renews Attack on Federal Welfare Programs
detail: At a Guanajuato state government economic-strategy event unveiling a push to attract AI, data-management, and technology investment, Vicente Fox praises the state's 'innovative, professional' plan and reiterates his critique of Morena's federal cash-transfer 'Bienestar' programs, arguing 'a la gente hay que darle preparación, no dinero para que esté de huevón' (people need training, not money that lets them sit idle) — extending a line of attack he first raised in June 2026 — and promotes his 'Alma de México' initiative aimed at identifying opposition leaders ahead of Mexico's 2027 midterm elections.

media.caption: Fox appears at a Guanajuato state economic-strategy event, renewing his critique of federal welfare programs
